does: Executes one stats functor in an attack-target context (called per functor by esv::ExecuteStatsFunctor_AttackTargetContext): copies the context's HitDesc (+0x140) and AttackDesc (+0x300), checks the functor's conditions, then dispatches on the functor's type byte (+0x45): ApplyStatus to code:unplaced::ExecuteApplyStatusFunctor, DealDamage to stats::DealDamageFunctor::ApplyDamage, a heal to code:unplaced::ExecuteRegainHitPointsFunctor, and so on.

evidence.says: a switch on the byte at +0x45 of its second argument; case 1 calls code:unplaced::ExecuteApplyStatusFunctor, case 2 reaches the level manager's surfaces, case 5 a summon

the call chains of a goblin weapon hit's first damage roll (via ApplyDamage), of the None roll between its attack and damage (via code:unplaced::ExecuteApplyStatusFunctor) and of POTION_OF_HEALING's heal roll (via code:unplaced::ExecuteRegainHitPointsFunctor) all pass it, called from bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x36D97D2 inside esv::ExecuteStatsFunctor_AttackTargetContext
